name: searchBy
label: Search by

options.label: Phone (digits contained in the stored phone)
Text (name, email, phone, CPF or CNPJ)

help: Email and phone return the oldest match first, the same contact Create or update a contact would update. Text returns the most recently updated first.

name: value
label: Value
help: The email, phone or text to search for. For phone, include the area code, for example `11 99999-0000`.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of contacts to return. Perpetuus is read in pages of 100, and further pages are requested until this number is reached. Leave it empty to return up to 100.
